Players Committee card image of [[Dash In Rogue 12 (Errata 4)]] (errata PC-E4), game text: “May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilot is •Dash, who provides ability of 3. During battle, if with another T-47 and about to draw a battle destiny, may draw two and choose one. Immune to attrition < 4.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Light/large/dashinrogue12.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/18da9058492b74388cd006f73993e32a5dbdeea7 18da905] (4 October 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
